colossus.nightmare_evolved.name: %s %s
commands.nightmare_evolved.colossus.unkn: No colossus is called %s. Try cairn_colossus, ossuary_behemoth, gravewyrm or chainbound_colossus.
commands.nightmare_evolved.vfx.shape: No effect is called that. Try one of: %s
creature.nightmare_evolved.title: %s %s
item.nightmare_evolved.soul_shard.desc: What remains of a slain creature's soul. Use it to draw its essence into your cores; sneak to take only one.
ability.nightmare_evolved.no_aspect: Your soul has no Aspect to call on yet.
ability.nightmare_evolved.locked: %s wakes only in a soul of the %s Rank.
commands.nightmare_evolved.soul.rank: Your soul now stands at the rank of %s.
commands.nightmare_evolved.soul.no_tier: No Aspect tier is called that. Try dormant, awakened, ascended or transcendent.
commands.nightmare_evolved.soul.reset: Your soul is an Aspirant's again, with no Aspect.
spell.nightmare_evolved.greeting: Aspirant. The Spell has taken hold of your soul, and it will not let go again.
spell.nightmare_evolved.greeting_trial: Your first trial lies on the far side of sleep. Lie down in a bed when you are ready, or answer now.
spell.nightmare_evolved.objective_slay: Endure what the Nightmare sends against you, and destroy whatever rules this place.
spell.nightmare_evolved.guardian: The master of this Nightmare has come: a %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.trial_conquered: You have conquered %s. The dream begins to come apart.
spell.nightmare_evolved.rank_reached: You have risen to the rank of %s. Your soul is %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.trial_failed: %s has closed over you. You wake, shaken, with part of what you gathered lost.
spell.nightmare_evolved.woke_home: The Nightmare you were in has dissolved. You wake where you last lay down.
spell.nightmare_evolved.no_more_trials: There is no trial left that the Spell can set you.
spell.nightmare_evolved.already_in_trial: You are already inside a Nightmare.
spell.nightmare_evolved.not_recovered: Your soul is still shaken by its last failure. Try again in %s seconds.
spell.nightmare_evolved.saturated: Your soul cores are full. Nothing more can be poured into them until you rise past this rank.
spell.nightmare_evolved.already_saturate: Your soul cores are full. The shard has nothing to give you.
spell.nightmare_evolved.no_core: Your soul has no core yet to hold the shard. Survive your first trial.
spell.nightmare_evolved.aspect_granted: An Aspect has woken in you: %s, of the %s Rank.
spell.nightmare_evolved.aspect_flaw: Every Aspect carries a Flaw. Yours is %s. %s
ability.nightmare_evolved.passive: %s is always with you; there is nothing to call.
ability.nightmare_evolved.faded: %s fades as your essence runs dry.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_step.no: There is no shadow there to step into.
Your soul holds no shadows yet. Slay something.
ability.nightmare_evolved.insight.name: Name: %s.
ability.nightmare_evolved.manifest_memor: You remember nothing to manifest. Read a creature's runes first.
ability.nightmare_evolved.mirror_walk.no: There is no reflection there to step through.
ability.nightmare_evolved.puppetry.none: Nothing you slew lately lies near enough to raise.
ability.nightmare_evolved.puppetry.full: You hold as many puppets as you can.
ability.nightmare_evolved.enchantment_ab: You let go of the enchantments you held.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.clear_cons: The unanswered question presses on you. Speak.
%s has asked you a question. You must answer.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.deathly_co: Your core is empty. Your body is a corpse until you kill again.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.sevenfold_: Another piece of you holds that power now.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.bare_hands: Enchanted things will not stay in your hands.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.binding_wo: You swore peace to this creature. You cannot harm it.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.still_wate: Your Aspect is silent while your heart is in turmoil.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.notice.mothers_lo: One who served you has fallen, and you grieve.
runes.nightmare_evolved.title: Runes
runes.nightmare_evolved.name: Name: %s.
runes.nightmare_evolved.fitting_flaw: The novel never names this Aspect's Flaw; this one suits it.
spell.nightmare_evolved.shards_useless: The shard has nothing your core can take.
spell.nightmare_evolved.new_core: Your soul tears, and a new core is born in it. You are a %s now.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.shadow_slave.de: Shadows heed you as nothing else does. They wrap you, carry you, take shape at your word, and keep what you slay.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.light_bringer.d: A creature of light cast into darkness. Your white flame mends and destroys, and every fire bends to you; but warmth costs you dearly.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.prince_of_nothi: Mirrors and reflections are doors to you, and a soul seen through the eyes is a soul within reach.
Mordret's Aspect (the novel gives it no name; this is his title)
aspect.nightmare_evolved.song_of_the_fal: To know: the runes of what you meet, the seconds before they come, the eyes of others, and the memories behind them.
Cassie's Aspect (her True Name; the novel never names the Aspect)
aspect.nightmare_evolved.soul_reaper.des: You live on what you reap. Your blows pass through flesh to the soul, and every kill fills you.
Metal knows your will. Your blade moves a little by thought, then flies, then a storm of blades answers.
Blood and decay are yours to command. Wounds you give grow worse, and the dead get up for you.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.raised_by_wolve: A warrior's body above all others: swifter, stronger, harder than steel, and a strength others draw from just by seeing you.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.princess_of_war: You are a blade yourself. What you touch grows sharp, your flesh is tempered, and enchantments flow into you.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.nightingale.des: Wings, eyes that pierce darkness and deceit, and a voice that the world cannot help but obey.
A monster's body, curses that open veins, and a strength that drinks the blood spilled around you.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.lightslayer.des: Elemental darkness floods wherever you are; it carries you, hides you, and makes you strong.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.beastmaster.des: Hexes that sap the will, senses led astray, and beasts brought to heel.
A hunter's eye that always knows where to strike, and a panther's body for the hunt.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.kindled_passion: Other hearts are yours to stoke and steer: rage, fear, love, all turned where you choose.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.huntress_bow.de: A bow that grows with you, arrows that fly true, and a centaur's grace.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.summer_knight.d: Rivers and lakes rise as weapons in your hands, and in the end your body becomes light.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.sky_tide.desc: The winds and the lightning are yours; as a Saint, a great white bird of prey wreathed in storm.
Golden lightning in arcs, bolts and walls; as a Saint, a winged white lion.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.stepping_air.de: You walk on the air itself and move in bursts too quick to follow.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.rose_aegis.desc: A shield of thorned roses. The novel shows only its bearer's temper; the rest is the mod's.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.moonlight.desc: A presence of true divinity that becomes a torrent of light and a wolf woven of moonlight.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.bright_lord.des: Master of the water, whose golden armour bent the will of all who saw themselves in it.
Speed beyond the eye's following. Every burst of it is borrowed from the end of your life.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.push_and_pull.d: Something close to gravity in your hands: crushing weight, and the power to throw foes off their feet.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.restoration_and: What is yours mends itself; what you strike begins to rot.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.phantom_blade.d: Your body can slip through matter for an instant, and your edge parts what armour would stop.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.flaw_sight.desc: A lesser gift of revelation: you see the weak points of living things, and can share the sight.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.wellspring.desc: You quicken the essence of those around you, and pour your own into them.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.charged_essence: Essence driven into things and turned to force or heat; your shots become charges.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.golden_hands.de: A gift for mending, restoring and growing things.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.distant_sky.des: The novel tells only that it woke, and that its bearer cannot kill. Here it binds and calls storms.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.deep_current.de: You belong to the water: swift in it, and untouchable as liquid within it.
aspect.nightmare_evolved.deep_current.be: Naeve of the House of Night's Aspect
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_bond.de: A divine shadow may be bound to a master who speaks its True Name.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_core.de: Your core is a black sun. It takes nothing from soul shards, but grows from every creature you kill yourself, and keeps that creature's shadow.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_control: Held: your shadow wraps your body, making you stronger, tougher and quicker; more so with every core.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_step.de: Step into a shadow you can see and out of it again. The range grows with your Rank.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_manifes: Shadows rise solid where you look, seize everything there and crush it. Far stronger in darkness.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shadow_incarna: Transformation: an avatar of shadow in your shape steps out for each of your cores, and fights beside you.
The shadows your core has kept rise as a legion and march for you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.halfbreed.desc: Whatever your flames destroy gives up some of its essence to you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.soul_flame.des: White flame that burns a foe's very soul; turned on yourself or an ally (or crouched), it heals instead.
ability.nightmare_evolved.flame_manipula: Hurl a torrent of white fire. No fire but your own can hurt you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.longing.desc: Your soul cannot be corrupted: poison, withering, sickness and hunger find no hold.
ability.nightmare_evolved.radiant_form.d: Transformation: a winged spirit of light. You fly, your blows set foes alight, fire cannot touch you, and essence mends your wounds.
ability.nightmare_evolved.dawn_star.desc: A white star falls where you look and breaks over everything there.
ability.nightmare_evolved.insight.desc: Read the runes of what you look at: its Rank, class, Aspect and Attributes (never its Flaw). Now and then, visions warn of what is coming.
ability.nightmare_evolved.premonition.de: You sense the next few seconds: everything near you stands outlined, and some blows find only where you were.
Look through the eyes of a creature or ally for a few seconds.
ability.nightmare_evolved.eyes_of_memory: Transformation: your eyes open. Whatever hunts you and meets your gaze forgets what it was doing, and your blindness lifts.
ability.nightmare_evolved.manifest_memor: Whatever you last read with Insight takes shape again and fights for you for a while.
ability.nightmare_evolved.true_sight.des: Held: you see far in darkness and through illusions, concealment and walls.
ability.nightmare_evolved.commanding_voi: Your voice makes foes falter and forget their prey, and gives your allies heart. Crouched, it is a crushing wave of sound.
ability.nightmare_evolved.midnight_drago: Transformation: a dragon with scales the colour of the night sky.
ability.nightmare_evolved.branded_word.d: Brand a word on the souls of allies nearby. Near you, they share your Domain's strength.
ability.nightmare_evolved.war_body.desc: Stronger, faster, quicker on your feet and harder to kill than any ordinary warrior.
Held: your whole body turns as hard as steel.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shared_might.d: Held: allies who can see you take a share of your might.
ability.nightmare_evolved.war_giantess.d: Transformation: you tower over the battlefield as a giant of steel.
The determination of those fighting beside you refills your essence.
ability.nightmare_evolved.reap_essence.d: Whatever you kill gives you its essence.
ability.nightmare_evolved.soul_strike.de: Held: your blows pass through armour and flesh to strike the soul.
ability.nightmare_evolved.core_reaping.d: Your kills feed your core directly, and while you are full of essence your body is driven far past its limits.
ability.nightmare_evolved.mist_wraith.de: Transformation: a wraith of chilling mist that nothing physical can touch.
ability.nightmare_evolved.soul_scythe.de: Your Legacy's scythe of mist sweeps all around you, reaping souls rather than flesh.
ability.nightmare_evolved.mirror_walk.de: Step through any reflection in sight (glass, ice or still water) and out beside it.
ability.nightmare_evolved.stolen_eyes.de: Meet a creature's gaze and take it: it fights for you until its will comes back.
ability.nightmare_evolved.mirror_realm.d: Draw a foe into the reflection and hold it there, out of the world, for a while.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shattered_refl: Transformation: your soul splits across reflections of you that fight at your side.
ability.nightmare_evolved.kingdom_of_not: Every foe around you falls into the mirror at once.
Whatever you wield cuts deeper, and your bare hands cut deepest of all.
ability.nightmare_evolved.tempered_flesh: Your body is as hard as tempered steel.
ability.nightmare_evolved.enchantment_ab: Draw the enchantments of what you hold into yourself, up to three, and fight with them. Crouched, let them go.
ability.nightmare_evolved.river_of_steel: Transformation: a river of living metal, swift and hard to wound.
One stroke that cleaves everything in a long line before you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.festering_woun: The wounds you give fester, growing worse each moment.
ability.nightmare_evolved.puppetry.desc: The last creature you slew rises again as your puppet.
ability.nightmare_evolved.transference.d: Harm done to you passes to one of your puppets instead.
Transformation: a living tide of blood that flows through the air and drowns what it touches.
ability.nightmare_evolved.authority_over: Creatures that die near you may rise as your puppets.
ability.nightmare_evolved.metal_affinity: Your blade moves a little by your will: swords and axes strike truer and harder.
ability.nightmare_evolved.flying_sword.d: A sword flies from your hand, hunts your foes and returns to circle you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.storm_of_sword: A host of flying blades rises around you and falls on everything that threatens you.
Now and then a creature you slay is beaten into a blade that remembers it. (What your Transformation is, no one has seen.)
ability.nightmare_evolved.sword_domain.d: Everyone near you who wields a sword grows stronger, and harm finds you less.
ability.nightmare_evolved.burst_of_speed: A flash forward too quick to follow, striking everything on the way.
ability.nightmare_evolved.quickened_hand: Your hands and feet keep pace with your speed.
ability.nightmare_evolved.afterimage.des: Strike every foe near you in the space of a breath.
Shove everything before you away hard, or (crouched) drag it in.
ability.nightmare_evolved.crushing_weigh: Your blows land with crushing weight and leave foes staggering.
ability.nightmare_evolved.mending_bulwar: Your armour and shield mend themselves as you fight.
ability.nightmare_evolved.corrosion.desc: Every blow you land leaves decay that piles up and eats away at the foe.
ability.nightmare_evolved.universal_rest: You and the allies near you heal, and what you carry mends.
ability.nightmare_evolved.phase.desc: For an instant your body passes through matter, and through whatever was about to hit you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.displacement_e: Held: an unseen edge around your blade parts flesh and armour alike.
ability.nightmare_evolved.kindle.desc: Whatever a creature feels burns hotter: a hunter turns reckless and careless of its guard, prey panics.
ability.nightmare_evolved.provoke.desc: Every foe near you is seized by rage and comes for you, heedless of its guard.
ability.nightmare_evolved.redirect.desc: Turn a foe's fury onto the creature nearest it, and that one answers in kind.
ability.nightmare_evolved.weak_points.de: Lay bare a foe's weak points: you and your allies hit it far harder.
ability.nightmare_evolved.shared_sight.d: Lay bare the weak points of every foe you can see, for all your allies.
ability.nightmare_evolved.essence_wellsp: Held: the essence of everyone near you comes back faster.
ability.nightmare_evolved.essence_transf: Pour your own essence into an ally.
ability.nightmare_evolved.charged_rounds: Held: what you shoot bursts with force where it strikes.
Turn essence into a blast of force and heat where you look.
ability.nightmare_evolved.golden_touch.d: Aimed at growing things, it makes the plants around flourish; otherwise it mends what you hold.
ability.nightmare_evolved.restoration.de: You and the allies near you heal.
ability.nightmare_evolved.monster_form.d: Held: you become something monstrous, taller and sharper-fanged, stronger and swifter.
ability.nightmare_evolved.bleeding_curse: Foes around you bleed from the eyes and mouth.
ability.nightmare_evolved.blood_frenzy.d: The more blood is flowing around you, the harder you strike.
Transformation: you grow monstrous, and your allies are changed with you, growing stronger.
ability.nightmare_evolved.flood_of_darkn: Elemental darkness floods the place you stand; foes inside are blinded and lose you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.dark_tide.desc: Dissolve into dark liquid and reform ahead of yourself.
ability.nightmare_evolved.darkborn_stren: In darkness you strike harder and are harder to hurt.
ability.nightmare_evolved.lightslayer_fo: Transformation: taller, horned, with great dark wings.
ability.nightmare_evolved.hex.desc: A hex that saps a foe's will: slower, weaker, clumsier.
ability.nightmare_evolved.phantoms.desc: Phantom copies of you appear, and foes lose sight of the real one.
ability.nightmare_evolved.beast_taming.d: Bring a creature to heel; it serves you for a long while.
ability.nightmare_evolved.ruinous_beauty: Transformation: a beauty that hurts to look at; creatures that see you forget to fight.
ability.nightmare_evolved.true_aim.desc: You always know where to aim: your shots strike harder, and often find a weak spot.
Held: crouched, you vanish from sight and your hunters lose you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.volley.desc: Loose a fan of arrows at once.
ability.nightmare_evolved.graceful_centa: Transformation: a towering, graceful centaur; your bow grows with you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.aegis.desc: A shell of essence that soaks up harm for a while.
Whatever strikes you is cut by your thorns.
ability.nightmare_evolved.water_whips.de: Water nearby rises and lashes the foes in front, dragging them in. With no water near, a lesser lash.
ability.nightmare_evolved.tide_mantle.de: Held: water shields you, best in rain or deep water.
Transformation: your body becomes light, and blows pass through it.
ability.nightmare_evolved.air_step.desc: Held: you walk on the air itself. Crouch to come down.
ability.nightmare_evolved.flash_step.des: Move so fast you seem to vanish and appear ahead.
ability.nightmare_evolved.golden_arcs.de: Held: golden lightning arcs from you into whatever comes close.
ability.nightmare_evolved.thunderbolt.de: Call lightning down where you look.
ability.nightmare_evolved.lightning_wall: A wall of lightning stands across your front, burning whatever crosses it.
ability.nightmare_evolved.winged_lion.de: Transformation: a great winged lion with white fur.
ability.nightmare_evolved.gale.desc: A gale hurls everything before you away.
ability.nightmare_evolved.storm_strike.d: Lightning falls on a single foe with all the storm's weight.
ability.nightmare_evolved.thunderbird.de: Transformation: a giant white bird of prey wreathed in thunderclouds; lightning leaps from you to your foes.
ability.nightmare_evolved.name_of_bindin: Bind a foe where it stands, weak and slow, without harming it.
Call a storm down where you look: it stuns and blinds more than it wounds.
ability.nightmare_evolved.tidecaller.des: You breathe long underwater and move through it swiftly.
ability.nightmare_evolved.liquid_body.de: In water your body turns liquid, and blows pass through it.
ability.nightmare_evolved.deep_breath.de: You breathe long underwater and swim swiftly.
Foes who can see you are cowed, and turn aside.
Vines erupt around you, snaring and cutting the foes they catch.
ability.nightmare_evolved.moonlit_veil.d: Held: you see by moonlight, and the night mends you.
ability.nightmare_evolved.lunar_lance.de: A lance of moonlight that strikes the soul.
ability.nightmare_evolved.moonlight_wolf: Transformation: a colossal wolf woven of moonlight.
You cannot lie, and a question put to you must be answered. Leave one hanging and the strain grows into pain until you speak.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.pristine_soul.des: You must suffer to use your power: every use burns you as if you were alive in a fire. The pain never kills.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.crown_of_thorns.d: You cannot kill. Your blows stop a breath short of death, and what you fell only collapses.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.blindness.desc: You are blind. As your Aspect grows, it becomes your sight.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.ear_for_lies.desc: You know every lie, and the ugliness behind it. Deceivers near you (the unseen, mimics, illusions) sicken you, though you see them plainly.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.ravenous_body.des: Your body needs far more than others'. You hunger quickly, and weaken when you go without.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.deathly_core.desc: Your soul is dead and your core broken. It makes no essence, leaks what it holds, and shards do nothing for it; only killing feeds it. Empty, you wither like a corpse.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.sevenfold_self.de: Your self is broken into seven pieces. Now and then another piece holds one of your powers, and it will not answer you.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.brittle_touch.des: Your touch makes things fragile. What you wield wears out far faster.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.forsaken_treasure: You must lose what you cherish. Things you have given names wear away while you carry them.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.mothers_love.desc: You love those who serve you. When one of them falls, the grief costs you strength and essence.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.borrowed_time.des: Each use of your power shortens your life: it takes a little of your health, which returns only slowly.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.endless_growth.de: Your body never stops growing. You grow larger and heavier with time, and slower for it.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.bare_hands.desc: You cannot use anything enchanted. Whatever enchanted thing you hold or wear slips from you.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.binding_word.desc: You cannot break a promise. Crouch and touch a creature with an empty hand to swear peace to it; you will never be able to harm it.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.rash_heart.desc: You are poor at holding back. Struck, you throw yourself at whatever struck you.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.still_waters.desc: Your Aspect answers only while your emotions are in check. Freshly hurt, or close to death, it falls silent.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.overlooked.desc: You are naturally unassuming. No one sees your name above you.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.forgotten_name.de: Everyone forgets your name, however often you tell them.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.unspoken.desc: The novel says only that this Flaw is plain to see. Here, your essence returns slowly when no one is near you.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.slow_well.desc: Your soul refills its essence slowly.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.hot_blood.desc: Every blow you take stokes your temper, until you charge in, stronger but heedless of your guard.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.lightless.desc: You cannot step into sunlight. Under the open daytime sky you burn.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.bloodthirst.desc: You crave blood. The taste of it drives you on; go too long without, and you weaken.
flaw.nightmare_evolved.landbound.desc: Your power belongs to the water. On dry land it costs twice as much and you move heavily.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.fated.desc: Fate bends around you: unlikely things happen, for good and ill. Now and then, death misses.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.mark_of_divi: A faint trace of divinity, as if you were touched by it once, long ago. Your blows against profane creatures land a little truer.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.spark_of_div: The trace of divinity has caught. Your blows against profane creatures land truer.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.ember_of_div: Divinity burns in you like an ember. Profane creatures suffer for it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.flame_of_div: Your soul burns with divine light. Profane creatures suffer greatly for it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.child_of_sha: Kin to the shadows: you see in the dark.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.master_of_sh: Shadows answer you. You see in the dark, and crouched in it, your hunters lose sight of you.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.lord_of_shad: Lord over shadows, even those of lesser living things. You see in the dark, hide in it, and strike far harder from it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.dreamspawn.d: Born of two worlds, welcome in neither. You are stronger, and harder to hurt, on the dreaming side.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.nephilim.des: Of the divine and the profane at once: beautiful, harrowing, and hardier than a human should be.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.swift_hand.d: Your blade strikes fast and true.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.shadow_sworn: Known to the shadows: crouched in darkness, you are hard to see.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.mark_of_deat: Made, like Death, to be a weapon. You are deadliest against the already failing.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.poet.desc: A gift for words that carry weight. Your power costs a little less and returns a little faster.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.godheart.des: Your soul is tied to the world's own essence. Rain and storms refill it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.lucky.desc: Fortune favours you. Now and then, a blow simply misses.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.marvel.desc: A marvellous learner. Your powers rest less between uses.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.battle_maste: Born for the battlefield: at home with any weapon.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.stalwart.des: Hard to hurt in any way, and your mind cannot be shaken.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.ravenous.des: An insatiable hunger, and the growth that comes of feeding it. Shards feed you more.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.lesser_iron_: A body tougher than flesh. It will grow tougher still.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.greater_stee: Your body has hardened from iron into steel.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.complete_ste: Your body is steel through and through, and hard to move.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.heart_of_dar: A trace of ancient darkness lives in your heart, and wakes when no light falls.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.dreadlord.de: Your might grows the more you are feared: the more that hunt you, the harder you strike back.
You walk dreams as others walk roads: quick on the dreaming side, and never troubled by sleeplessness.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.spirit_guide: You draw in the world's essence faster.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.shadow_guide: Essence flows through you with a guide: spent more slowly, recovered more quickly.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.soul_compani: Companions bound to you thrive near you.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.the_fire.des: The Sun God's lineage, in your blood: fire troubles you less, and your essence burns brighter.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.the_blood.de: The heart of the Beast God's lineage: beasts recognise their better and strike you less hard.
A part of Weaver's forbidden lineage in your blood: it will not stop flowing, and your body mends itself.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.bone_weave.d: Weaver's lineage in your bones: they do not break, and your hands grow finely sensitive.
Weaver's lineage in your flesh: stronger, and harder to wound.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.mind_weave.d: Weaver's lineage in your mind: sharp, and closed to whatever would cloud it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.soul_weave.d: Weaver's lineage in your soul itself: sturdier, and quicker to recover its essence.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.marble_shell: The first shell of a soulbound mantle forged in the Underworld: skin like stone.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.onyx_shell.d: The mantle's second shell: skin like dark stone, harder still.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.jade_shell.d: The mantle's final shell: skin like jade, all but unbreakable.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.blessing.des: A sword bound to your soul and merged with it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.curse.desc: A charm of seven black rings bound to your soul: whatever strikes you is weakened in turn.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.dragonslayer: Earned by slaying a dragon: stronger, tougher, and hard to burn.
Left by rings of ash: at home in great heat, and stronger for it.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.mark_of_shad: Marked by a Lord of Shadows: shadows lend their help, and power costs a little less.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.fateless.des: Cut loose from fate: no one remembers, nothing is destined, and no True Name can be earned.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.enthralled.d: Made a thrall: your will is not quite your own. It passes in time.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.dark_destrie: An Echo's or Shadow's: a steed for a shadow warrior, stronger amid darkness.
An Echo's or Shadow's: it can take the shape of a weapon.
attribute.nightmare_evolved.soul_beast.d: An Echo's or Shadow's: a beast of the soul that grows with its master.
memory.nightmare_evolved.runes.shard: A Shard Memory: it outlives whoever holds it.
memory.nightmare_evolved.runes.filled: (The novel never shows its powers; these are the mod's reading of it.)
memory.nightmare_evolved.runes.ownerless: It belongs to no one. Whoever takes it up first will bind it.
A tachi of bright star-metal on a hilt of black wood. It does not break, and it does not yield.
memory.nightmare_evolved.zenith_shard.de: A bronze spear, its head forged from a fallen star, lighter than it looks.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dawn_shard.desc: A plain band of metal set with one gem. Every Memory near it shines brighter.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dusk_shard.desc: A heavy round shield, as light or as heavy as its bearer wills it.
memory.nightmare_evolved.moonlight_shard: A ghostly stiletto that is simply in its owner's hand the moment they want it.
A graceful war hammer, one side of its head shaped into a narrow beak.
memory.nightmare_evolved.starlight_shard: A flowing white cloak, cool as starlight on the skin.
A bottle of patterned blue glass that is never quite empty for long.
memory.nightmare_evolved.silver_bell.des: A small silver bell. Rung, it carries much farther than it has any right to.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dream_blade.des: A plain silver longsword. It guards the soul a little, which is more than most swords do.
memory.nightmare_evolved.evertwine.desc: A coil of golden rope that always seems to reach exactly as far as it needs to.
memory.nightmare_evolved.azure_blade.des: A straight blade the colour of a clear sky, cut from a scavenger's shell.
memory.nightmare_evolved.starlight_legio: The bright armour of a legion that once fought on the Forgotten Shore.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dark_wing.desc: A cloak as clear and light as a dragonfly's wings, and as hard to tear.
memory.nightmare_evolved.puppeteers_shro: Dark grey silk and soft boots, woven from what a worm of doubt left behind.
memory.nightmare_evolved.blood_blossom.d: A red flower that never wilts. Everything its owner commands grows thirsty.
memory.nightmare_evolved.broken_oath.des: A cracked charm. Standing near whoever wears it wears the soul down.
A thorny dagger on a string no one can see. It always comes back. Almost always.
memory.nightmare_evolved.extraordinary_r: It is a rock. It is, however, an extraordinary one.
memory.nightmare_evolved.heavenly_burden: A golden needle. Whatever it pierces forgets how to stay on the ground.
A quiver that is never empty, as long as its owner has essence to spare.
memory.nightmare_evolved.silent_dagger.d: A slim dark dagger. Nothing its bearer does makes a sound.
memory.nightmare_evolved.enchanted_bag.d: A leather bag far bigger inside than out. It does tend to spill.
memory.nightmare_evolved.blood_arrow.des: An arrow made of its archer's blood, which it takes back from whatever it strikes.
memory.nightmare_evolved.blackhorn_bow.d: A bow of horn and black wood, stronger and sturdier than it ought to be.
memory.nightmare_evolved.full_quiver.des: Not one arrow but a whole quiver of them, which never quite runs out.
memory.nightmare_evolved.strike_of_thund: An arrow that flies like lightning and does not stop at one target.
memory.nightmare_evolved.cruel_sight.des: A blade of mirror-bright steel that can be a sword or a spear, and drinks in light.
memory.nightmare_evolved.covetous_coffer: A chest that is bigger inside, follows its owner around, and bites thieves.
A great bow made for a princess of war. Its arrows are made of its wielder's soul.
A warm charm. Flame bites its wearer less.
memory.nightmare_evolved.memory_of_ice.d: A cool charm. Cold bites its wearer less.
memory.nightmare_evolved.mirror_of_truth: A silver hand mirror that keeps the reflection of what it is shown.
memory.nightmare_evolved.patient_avenger: A tower shield that remembers every blow it stops, and gives them back.
memory.nightmare_evolved.bitter_cusp.des: A cup that is always full of something bitter and poisonous. Do not drink it.
memory.nightmare_evolved.nameless_sun.de: A blade like a splinter of daylight, taken from the Crimson Terror.
memory.nightmare_evolved.mantle_of_the_u: Armour of living stone from beneath the mountains. It grows with every victory.
memory.nightmare_evolved.bag_of_withhold: A small pack, bigger inside, that holds on to what it holds.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dire_warning.de: A charm that tells lesser creatures to stay away. They listen.
memory.nightmare_evolved.altar_of_denial: A small white altar. Powers come cheaper to one who stands still before it.
A black mantle that keeps its wearer whole, hidden, and unappetising.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dying_wish.desc: A charm that makes everyone who sees its wearer feel something urgent.
memory.nightmare_evolved.shroud_of_grace: Robes of sublime silk, blessed by the last sybil of a drowned city.
memory.nightmare_evolved.sin_of_solace.d: A sword of perfect jade that wounds the mind as well as the body, including its wielder's.
A charm of black rings. Silence makes its master strong; a word after silence is law.
memory.nightmare_evolved.undying_chain.d: Chains that will not let their wearer die, for as long as they hold.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dark_shaper.des: A mallet of black tomb-stone that reshapes whatever it strikes.
memory.nightmare_evolved.crown_of_twilig: A crown of a drowned king: strength at dusk and dawn, and a temper to match.
memory.nightmare_evolved.crown_of_dawn.d: The Dawn Shard raised to a crown. Every Memory near it burns brighter still.
memory.nightmare_evolved.beast_locket.de: An iron locket with a sunlit meadow inside, where living things can be kept.
memory.nightmare_evolved.condemnation.de: A greatsword with a flowing pattern in its steel, dreadful to stand near.
memory.nightmare_evolved.evening_star.de: A star carved from amber. It makes its owner more, in every way there is.
memory.nightmare_evolved.weavers_mask.de: A mask of the Demon of Fate, threaded through with something that is not quite light.
A lantern that eats light and holds shadows, any number of them.
memory.nightmare_evolved.drop_of_ichor.d: A single golden drop of divine blood, from a lineage of weavers.
memory.nightmare_evolved.blade.desc: A blade the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.spear.desc: A spear the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.axe.desc: An axe the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dagger.desc: A dagger the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.bow.desc: A bow the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.shield.desc: A shield the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.bone_mail.desc: Armour of bone, woven from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.chitin_mail.des: Armour of chitin, woven from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.plate_mail.desc: Armour of dark plate, woven from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.charm.desc: A charm the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.cloak.desc: A cloak the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.lantern.desc: A lantern the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.canteen.desc: A canteen the Spell wove from a slain creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.horn.desc: A horn the Spell wove from a slain creature.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.hungering.desc: Each blow returns a little of the wielder's health.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.searing.desc: Its blows set what they strike alight.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.frostbitten.de: Its blows chill, slowing what they strike.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.rending.desc: Its blows leave wounds that keep bleeding.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.thundering.des: Now and then a blow arcs on to nearby foes.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.weighty.desc: Its blows knock foes back and stagger them.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.ghost_edge.des: It cuts spirits and the bone-dead deeply.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.warding.desc: Attacks on the soul and mind land softer.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.steadfast.desc: Its wearer is hard to knock back.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.clear_mind.des: Nausea and darkness pass at once.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.night_eyes.des: Its wearer sees in the dark.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.shrouded.desc: Crouching still, its wearer cannot be seen.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.weatherward.de: Its wearer never freezes, and storms bite less.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.softstep.desc: Short falls do no harm, and long ones less.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.durable.desc: It lasts far longer before it would break.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.swift_summon.d: It appears at once, without gathering.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.tethered.desc: Its essence comes back however far away it is dismissed.
It mends itself even while summoned.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.wayfinder.desc: Held, it lights the dark and shows lurking creatures.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.spring_water.d: Drink to quench hunger and put out flames.
Sound it to rouse every ally nearby. Costs essence.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.unbroken.desc: Near impossible to break; fiercest when its wielder is nearly dead.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.zenith.desc: It strikes hardest falling on its foe from above.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.dawn.desc: Every Memory nearby grows stronger, the weaker ones the most.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.indomitable.de: Its weight is its bearer's to choose: steadier held, crushing in a block.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.unseen.desc: It is in the hand the instant it is wanted; it finds the unwary.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sunlight.desc: Its blows stagger, and burn whatever hides from the sun.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.starlight.desc: Under an open night sky, its wearer heals and quickens.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.glide.desc: Drift down softly, hang above the ground (crouch in the air), skim water.
Attacks on the soul land softer while it is held.
Drink from it, or pour out water. It refills over time.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.blessing_of_fl: The body tires more slowly and recovers sooner.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.blessing_of_sp: The mind tires more slowly and recovers sooner.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.doubtless.desc: A little protection against what would get into the mind.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.silver_song.de: Rung, it is heard across a vast distance.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sonorous.desc: Its owner chooses how loud it rings (crouch to ring softly).
enchant.nightmare_evolved.flower_of_evil: Its owner's Memories, Echoes and Shadows thirst for blood, and grow stronger.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.oathbreaker.de: It wears away the soul of anyone who comes near its wearer.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.rose_of_betray: Throw it; an unseen string brings it back. Now and then it snaps.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.not_really.des: Throw it. It lands far harder than any rock should.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.unburdened.des: What it pierces rises into the sky. Crouch and use it to rise yourself.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.golden_twine.d: It pulls its owner to what they point at, or binds a creature fast.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.essence_arrows: Arrows woven from essence, one essence apiece.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.hush.desc: Its bearer makes no sound; its first cut finds the unwary.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.spilling_bag.d: Holds far more than it should, but spills it all when dismissed.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.withholding.de: Holds far more than it should, and keeps it through every summoning.
Its arrows are made of the archer's blood, a little per shot.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.restitution.de: A hit drinks back the archer's blood, and more.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.unyielding_hor: Strong and sturdy far beyond its make.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.endless_volley: A whole quiver of arrows that never runs dry.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.caged_lightnin: It flies straight as lightning and leaps on to foes nearby.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.shapeshifter.d: A sword or a spear (crouch and use it to change).
enchant.nightmare_evolved.light_eater.de: It drinks in bright light, then pours it out as a lance.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.ghost_blade.de: It cuts what has no body.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.dark_mirror.de: Its blows carry the last element its wielder was hurt by.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.mendacious_cof: It can pass for something else (crouch and use it on a block).
enchant.nightmare_evolved.capacious_ches: Far bigger inside, and it keeps what it holds.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.locomotive_chi: Set it down and it walks after you.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.lurid_trunk.de: Anyone else who opens it is bitten.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.soul_arrows.de: With no arrows, it makes its own from the wielder's soul.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.unbending.desc: It all but never wears out.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.burden_of_peac: Whatever its arrows pierce grows terribly heavy.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.death_dealer.d: Crouch at full draw to spend much essence on an obliterating shot.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.scorching_heat: Fire harms its wearer half as much.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.bitter_cold.de: Cold harms its wearer half as much.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.searching_refl: Catch a creature's reflection; break the mirror to borrow its power.
It keeps the heat it stops; crouch and use it to let it out.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.cold_steel.des: It keeps the force it stops, to let out as a wave of fire.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.bitter_draught: Pour it over a blade: the next blows poison.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.radiance.desc: What it cuts burns, and the undead burn worst.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.living_stone.d: The armour mends itself while worn.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.feather_of_tru: Its weight is the wearer's to change: falls are soft, or a plunge.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.stalwart.desc: Very hard to harm with blows, hard with elements.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.underworld_arm: It takes in a worn charm and makes it stronger.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.prince_of_the_: It grows stronger with every foe its wearer fells.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.soulbound_reli: It can be bound to its owner's soul for good, becoming part of them.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.dire_warning.d: Creatures of lesser Rank than its owner keep away.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.denial.desc: Powers cost less while its owner stands still.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.enduring.desc: It spares its wearer something of every blow.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.concealing.des: Creatures lose track of its wearer at a distance.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.tasteless.desc: Nothing finds its wearer appetising; poison and hunger pass.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.death_wish.des: Allies take heart, foes come for its wearer, and its wearer grows stronger.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sharpened_mind: A clearer mind; powers rest a little less.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sublime_silk.d: Impervious silk that spares its wearer something of every blow.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sybils_blessin: A link of the mind to one other: crouch and touch them with an open hand.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sinister_whisp: It wounds the mind along with the body.
Held, it weakens the will of every foe nearby.
The more its wielder's sanity breaks, the stronger it becomes.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.cursed.desc: It slowly drives its wielder mad. The whispers fade while it rests.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.silent_might.d: The longer its master keeps silent, the stronger they become.
After a great silence, the first word spoken is a command.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.chains_of_long: Chains lash out at whoever hurts its wearer.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.brilliant_will: An unbending will; the mind can't be clouded.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.undying.desc: Its wearer can not die. The chain bears the cost; if it breaks, so does the promise.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.sculptors_will: It reshapes a block it strikes: full, stair, slab, wall.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.legacy_of_twil: Essence floods back at dusk and at dawn.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.kings_resentme: No mind can touch its wearer's, but every hurt kindles wrath.
In water, its wearer is its master.
It keeps creatures in the meadow inside it; crouch and use it to free them.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.judgement.desc: It cuts through armour, and its presence weakens foes.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.boundless_powe: Stronger, tougher, quicker, and quicker to recover.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.where_is_my_ey: A glimpse of Fate: sometimes a blow is seen before it lands.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.simple_trick.d: Its wearer's Flaw has no hold on them while it is worn.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.gates_of_shado: It gathers shadows in the dark, and sets them loose.
enchant.nightmare_evolved.weavers_lineag: Consumed, it becomes a Weave in its consumer's blood.
memory.nightmare_evolved.no_room: There is nowhere for it to take shape: free a hand or a slot.
memory.nightmare_evolved.not_yours: This Memory is bound to another soul. It will not answer you.
memory.nightmare_evolved.dry: It has run dry for now. It will fill again.
memory.nightmare_evolved.silver_bell.hea: A silver bell rings far away: %s, to the %s, %s blocks off.
memory.nightmare_evolved.covetous_coffer: The coffer takes on the look of %s.
memory.nightmare_evolved.mirror_of_truth: The mirror keeps the reflection of %s.
The mirror holds the reflection of %s. Crouch and use it to break it.
memory.nightmare_evolved.patient_avenger: The shield has not kept enough to give back yet.
memory.nightmare_evolved.bitter_cusp.dru: You were told not to drink it.
The string snaps. The thorn lies where it fell.
memory.nightmare_evolved.beast_locket.re: The locket will not take that creature.
memory.nightmare_evolved.beast_locket.ke: The meadow in the locket now keeps %s.
memory.nightmare_evolved.lineage_full: You already carry everything this lineage can give.
memory.nightmare_evolved.relic_confirm: Bind %s to your soul for good? It will be gone as a Memory. Do it again to bind it.
memory.nightmare_evolved.mirror_of_truth: You borrow the endurance of the dead.
You borrow a hunter's speed and strength.
You borrow the ease of the deep.
You borrow its kinship with flame.
You borrow its hold on the void.
You borrow a craftsman's quick hands.
You borrow something. You are not sure what.
memory.nightmare_evolved.sin_of_solace.w: Truth is a blade, and you are holding it by the edge.
They are lying to you. All of them.
Let go. Just a little. It feels so much better.
You were always meant to be this.
Do you hear it too? The singing under the stone?
spell.nightmare_evolved.memory_received: A Memory takes shape in your soul: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.memory_overflow: Your soul can hold no more Memories.
spell.nightmare_evolved.oath_keys: The seven Shards answer one another. From them, the Oath Keys take shape.
spell.nightmare_evolved.memory_claimed: An ownerless Memory binds itself to you: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.memory_layer_des: A layer of your Memory is destroyed: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.memories_lost: Your Memories and Echoes are gone with you.
spell.nightmare_evolved.lineage: A lineage awakens in your blood: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.relic_bound: The relic is bound. %s is part of you now.
spell.nightmare_evolved.echo_received: An Echo is frozen into your soul: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.echo_overflow: Your soul can hold no more Echoes.
spell.nightmare_evolved.shadow_sleeps: Your Shadow is badly hurt and falls into a long sleep: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.shadow_made: A living shadow takes the place of the Echo's weave. It is a Shadow now: %s.
spell.nightmare_evolved.soul_sea_first: You stand on the still water of your own Soul Sea. Everything you are is here.
echo.nightmare_evolved.echo_limit: You can call no more than %s Echoes at once.
echo.nightmare_evolved.shadow.not_aspect: Only the Shadow Slave can make an Echo into a Shadow.
echo.nightmare_evolved.shadow.no_match: No shadow of its kind stands in your Soul Sea.
echo.nightmare_evolved.shadow.no_core: Each Shadow needs a core of its own, and every core already holds one.
echo_trait.nightmare_evolved.battle_mast: Skilled in every kind of fighting.
echo_trait.nightmare_evolved.stalwart.de: Shrugs off harm, and nothing clouds its mind.
Recovers whenever it is not fighting.
echo_trait.nightmare_evolved.shadow_swor: Known to shadows; stronger in the dark.
echo_trait.nightmare_evolved.dark_destri: A steed for a shadow warrior, swifter and stronger in the dark.
echo_trait.nightmare_evolved.soul_weapon: A weapon at heart; its blows land harder.
A beast of the soul that grows with its master.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.meditating: You still yourself and sink inward...
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.no_sea: You have no Soul Sea yet. It forms after the First Nightmare.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.not_now: You need to be standing still on solid ground.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.fighting: You are too shaken by the fight to sink inward.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.missing: The Soul Sea is missing from this world.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.moved: You moved, and the stillness breaks.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.torn_back: Your body is struck! You are torn back into it.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.boundary: Your sea turns you back toward its heart.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.slain_shadow: The shadow of a slain %s stands here, silent, guarding you.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.vault_locked: Only a Sovereign's Soul Sea can keep things.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.shadow.1: It looks at you as if you had said something foolish.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.shadow.3: It points at the suns, then at you.
soul_sea.nightmare_evolved.shadow.4: It does a little bow. Mockingly, you suspect.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.keys: %s: go down into your Soul Sea · %s: dismiss the Memory in hand
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.no_sea: An Aspirant has no soul core yet, and so no Soul Sea and no Memories.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.no_memorie: Your soul holds no Memories yet. The Spell gives them for kills, more often for rarer prey.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.no_echoes: Your soul holds no Echoes yet. The Spell gives them rarely, for kills.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.cost: Summoning costs %s essence; dismissing it nearby gives it back.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.sink: Go down into your Soul Sea
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.sink.desc: Stand still, away from any fight. Your body stays where you leave it, and if anything strikes it, you are torn back.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.rise.desc: Your mind returns to your body, wherever it sits.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.echo_limit: You can call up to %s Echoes at once.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.no_citadel: No Citadel is bound to your soul. A Saint who claims one sees its likeness rise in their sea.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.citadel: Bound Citadel: %s. Its likeness stands at the heart of your sea.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.vault: Open what your Soul Sea keeps
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.vault.desc: A Sovereign's soul can hold plain things as well as Memories.
soul.nightmare_evolved.screen.vault_lock: A Sovereign's Soul Sea can keep plain things too. Yours cannot yet.
key.nightmare_evolved.soul_sea: Sink into the Soul Sea / rise
block.nightmare_evolved.soul_sea_surface: Still Water of the Soul Sea
gamerule.keepSoulMemories: Keep Memories and Echoes through death
gamerule.keepSoulMemories.description: As in the novel, a soul's Memories and Echoes die with it (all but the Shard Memories). Turn this on to keep them.
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.crimson_c: %1$s was cut to ribbons by crimson coral
%1$s was cut to ribbons by crimson coral while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.dark_sea: %1$s was taken by the Dark Sea
%1$s was taken by the Dark Sea while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.crushing: %1$s was crushed by the weight of the sky
%1$s was crushed by the weight of the sky while fighting %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.nothingne: %1$s dissolved into the mist while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.white_sky: %1$s was erased by the white sky
%1$s was erased by the white sky while fighting %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.bone_sea: %1$s was eaten away by the Bone Sea
%1$s was eaten away by the Bone Sea while fleeing %2$s
death.attack.nightmare_evolved.focused_s: %1$s was burned by gathered sunlight while fighting %2$s
